frontend: Dolphin 2606a (Dolphin.app), isolated user folder (-u), batch mode (-b), input from a TAS movie (-m)
input: work/standalone/tools/gen_dtm.py: a .dtm (header bSaveConfig=0, md5 zero, tickCount set) with one GC pad; Dolphin stopped with SIGINT ~80 s in (graceful stop)

layout.save_dir: <user>/GC/<region>/Card A/ (Dolphin default for slot A is now a GCI folder, EXI device type 8; a raw MemoryCardA.USA.raw is only used when slot A is set to Memory Card)
layout.name: <maker code>-<game code>-<card file name>.gci, here 01-GM4E-MarioKart Double Dash!!.gci: a 64-byte GCI header (the card directory entry) + the save blocks (3 x 8 KiB)
layout.other: GC/SRAM.raw (68 bytes): the emulated IPL SRAM (clock bias, language, slot flags), written on stop; not a game save

note: The game asked 'Would you like to create data for MARIO KART: DOUBLE DASH!! on the Memory Card in Slot A?', the movie's A chose YES, then 'Data has been created.' (proof.png, a Dolphin frame dump, frame 1200). A placeholder.txt was put in the empty Card A folder beforehand: with an empty GCI folder Dolphin treats a movie as starting from a clear save and writes to GC/USA/Movie/Card A/ instead (seen in a first run). The GCI's modified-time field (0x327DAA76) comes from the emulated clock, which a movie sets from its recordingStartTime.
